title: Allegiant Travel CO 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: Allegiant Travel Company filed an 8-K on April 15, 2026 announcing that the Department of Transportation granted an interim exemption for the company's proposed merger with Sun Country Airlines, satisfying a key regulatory condition for the transaction to close.
key_points: Allegiant and Sun Country entered into a merger agreement on January 11, 2026
The merger consists of a two-step process where Sun Country first merges into a wholly-owned subsidiary and then into another subsidiary of Allegiant
The DOT granted the requested interim exemption on April 15, 2026
The merger remains conditioned on other approvals beyond the DOT exemption
The companies issued a joint press release attached as Exhibit 99.1
